integrity: Analytic proofs of all-horizon and asymptotic results; exact finite rational enumeration is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Stationary, marginally fair, symmetric first-order two-state rainfall occurrence model only; no dependence of rainfall intensity or storm duration.
The wet-wet run indicator is an observational persistence index and not a model of flood impacts.
Finite-horizon uniqueness is established for four days and all sufficiently large horizons, not for every intermediate horizon.
Earlier optimized-run consequences of the published general Markov run distributions remain a historical-priority risk.
title: A one-fifth correlation limit for paired-wet-spell risk
